title: I'm getting an error like "This version of dbt is not supported with the 'dbt_utils' package." PS: I'm using mac m1
answer:
You're running an old version of dbt-core. Try upgrading it with pip, it should match the requirements of dbt-utils.

pip install -U dbt-core
